notes: DHIS2 is an open-source health information platform whose core server generates its own OpenAPI 3.0 document at /api/openapi/openapi.json. This is that document, captured verbatim from the DHIS2 project's own public play instance running stable 2.43.2.1 (/api/system/info reports version 2.43.2.1, revision 2003187; info.version inside the spec still reads 2.42, which is DHIS2's own labelling and is left untouched). 1780 paths / 2575 operations / 926 schemas, replacing a 20 KiB hand-made test fixture that covered a token slice of the API. Full coverage matters more here than for most adaptors: @openfn/language-dhis2 exposes only generic CRUD builders (create, get, update, upsert, destroy) over an arbitrary resource path, so a job can reach any endpoint in this file. servers[0].url points at the demo host because DHIS2 is self-hosted and has no single production base URL - the adaptor takes the host from state.configuration.hostUrl and prefixes /api (optionally /api/{apiVersion}). Two upstream quirks are preserved as-is: path keys carry a #operationName fragment where DHIS2 disambiguates several operations on one path, and the legacy /api/events and /api/trackedEntityInstances endpoints are absent because 2.41+ replaced them with /api/tracker/*. The spec endpoint is only served to a logged-in client, so re-checking drift needs the public demo login documented at https://dhis2.org/demo; the contentHash will also move whenever the play instance is rebuilt on a newer patch, and the instance name (and so the specUrl) changes with each patch release - the live list is https://api.im.dhis2.org/instances/public (play.dhis2.org redirects to its UI). Re-captured 2026-11-16 from stable-2-43-2-1 after stable-2-43-1 was retired: against 2.43.1 this adds POST /api/auth/updatePassword (schema UpdatePasswordRequest), swaps which of the two POST /api/email/notification operations carries the #fragment key (sendSystemNotificationEmail now, sendEmailNotification before; both operations still present), and changes 21 operations and 8 schemas in place (ErrorCode, Grid, OrganisationUnit, Program, ProgramParams, ProgramPropertyNames, SystemSettings, TrackerRelationship); nothing was removed. Two things this document cannot express, both found by checking mock traffic against it: (1) it describes 2.43 only, so endpoints DHIS2 has since removed — notably the legacy POST /api/trackedEntityInstances, superseded by /api/tracker — match no operation even though instances on 2.40 and earlier still serve them; and (2) every path is written without DHIS2's optional API-version segment, so a real request to /api/40/organisationUnits matches nothing. It also models nested metadata as full objects, while DHIS2 returns id-only references ({"id": "..."}) unless `fields` asks for more, so a conforming payload will report the nested object's required properties as missing.
